name: heirloom
description: Wraps up work done by external SDLC tools: prepares handoffs, collects human approval of PR summaries and decisions in a local dashboard, and preserves active decisions and axioms for the next task.

interface.longDescription: Heirloom prepares a handoff when spec-based work is done, lets you approve the PR summary and decision drafts in a local dashboard, records the approved decisions and axioms in the repository, opens the PR and serves the active decisions to later work.
